skills.name: Double Stab
skills.description: Quickly stab a nearby enemy twice. Can only be used when equipped with a dagger.

skills.name: Lucky Seven
skills.description: Throw 7 lucky throwing stars to attack enemies in front. Can only be used when equipped with a claw.

skills.name: Haste
skills.description: Permanently increases Speed, Jump, and Max Speed.

skills.name: Dark Sight
skills.description: Allows you to hide in the shadows for a short time to avoid the enemy's attack. While Dark Sight is active, you can deactivate it either by using another skill or by pressing the Dark Sight skill key again. Note that certain movement skills will not cancel Dark Sight. Upon deactivating Dark Sight, its cooldown will vary according to damage dodged in proportion to your to Max HP.

skills.name: Flash Jump
skills.description: Use while in the middle of a jump to jump even farther. The higher this skill's level, the farther you will jump. Can be activated with the Jump key.

skills.name: Nimble Body
skills.description: Permanently increases Luck.

skills.name: Magic Theft
skills.description: Chance to steal a target's buff for yourself.

skills.name: Flash Jump
skills.description: Use while in the middle of a jump to jump twice in a row. The jump distance increases as the skill level increases. Can also be used with the Jump Key.

skills.name: Side Step
skills.description: Permanently increases Avoidability.

skills.name: Bandit Slash
skills.description: Lash out at a group of enemies with crossing blades.

skills.name: Savage Blow
skills.description: Deals very quick consecutive attacks to the enemy in front.

skills.name: Critical Edge
skills.description: Permanently increases Critical Rate and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Steal
skills.description: Grants your attack skills a chance to steal a potion that immediately recovers either HP or MP upon striking an enemy.\nYou can steal only one potion per enemy, although you can repeatedly attempt to steal until you succeed. Potions stolen from bosses fully restore your HP and MP, and boost Attack Power for a short time.

skills.name: Agile Daggers
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Luck.

skills.name: Channel Karma
skills.description: Increase your Attack Power and your ability to resist knockback effects when struck.

skills.name: Dagger Mastery
skills.description: Increases Dagger Mastery and Final Damage.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases LUK and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Shield Mastery
skills.description: Increases DEF, Avoidability, and Attack Power when a shield or dagger scabbard is equipped, and reduces damage taken.

skills.name: Bandit's Agility
skills.description: Harness the agility of an assassin to gain the ability to Flash Jump upwards.

skills.name: Midnight Carnival
skills.description: Overwhelm enemies with supersonic slashes.

skills.name: Phase Dash
skills.description: Dashes at the enemy with blinding speed, damaging and knocking them back. Can be resisted by some monsters.

skills.name: Meso Explosion
skills.description: Fling Mesos, dropped by Pick Pocket, to damage enemies.

skills.name: Dark Flare
skills.description: Release dark energy for a certain period of time to summon a large dagger, which attacks enemies nearby. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Pick Pocket
skills.description: Cause 1 Meso to drop every time you attack with your skills (excludes Meso Explosion, 1st Job Skills, 5th Job Common Skills, and Summoner attacks). Pick Pocket and Blood Money cannot be used at the same time.\nCan be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Shadow Partner
skills.description: Summon a shadow partner that mimics the summoner. It does not have its own HP, and disappears when it is hit with an attack that changes its appearance or restricts movement. It cannot mimic Meso Explosion, summoned monsters, 5th Job Common Skills, or certain other skills.

skills.name: Advanced Dark Sight
skills.description: Hones your stealth technique, giving you a chance of not breaking Dark Sight when you attack or use skills in Dark Sight. Has a chance to automatically trigger Dark Sight when attacked, and attacking from Dark Sight will increase Final Damage.\nHowever, if you dodge an attack that deals damage proportional to Max HP, using the Dark Sight that activates when you are hit, the cooldown will not apply, and Dark Sight's duration will decrease.

skills.name: Into Darkness
skills.description: Melt into the darkness and teleport behind the furthest enemy in range. Prioritizes the enemy with the highest Max HP first. You remain in Dark Sight after teleporting, and the cooldown is shared with Dark Sight.

skills.name: Venom
skills.description: Permanently coats your dagger with venom, giving all your attacks the chance to Poison enemies. Poison is not stackable, and it cannot cause enemies' HP to drop below 1.

skills.name: Meso Mastery
skills.description: Increase Attack Power, amount of Mesos that drop, and Meso Explosion's damage.

skills.name: Enveloping Darkness
skills.description: Cloaks yourself in darkness, increasing Max HP, Abnormal Status Resistance and Elemental Resistance permanently.

skills.name: Meso Explosion
skills.description: Sends nearby Mesos flying to damage enemies. Mesos that belong to others cannot be moved.\nRequired Skill: Pick Pocket Lv. 1

skills.name: Assassinate
skills.description: Attack an enemy's vital points over and over to deal tremendous damage. Cast the Assassinate skill once more after the first strike to deal a finishing blow. After the final blow, you will no longer be hidden. Also, you can deal a stronger final blow of Assassinate if you have the Murderous Intent buff. The Murderous Intent buff is consumed when enemy is hit. Targets the enemy with the highest HP first. During the use of this skill, no enemy attack can knock you back.

skills.name: Cruel Stab
skills.description: Inflicts a brutal stab with the dagger. Pick Pocket's Meso drop rate is halved for this skill. Permanently increases Final Damage.

skills.name: Blood Money
skills.description: Drops coins branded with an Assassin's Mark. Enhances Meso Explosion. Using Meso Explosion while this skill is active grants the Murderous Intent buff which enhances your next Assassinate's final blow. Pick Pocket and Bloody Money cannot be active at the same time. Mesos created with Blood Money will attack the boss with the highest HP first when detonated with Meso Explosion. Permanently increases Luck and Critical Damage. Unaffected by Combat Orders.\nWhen used, the effect is activated and can be toggled On/Off\nRight-click to lock Murderous Intent effect.

skills.name: Meso Explosion
skills.description: Detonates the coins dropped by Blood Money. Grants the Murderous Intent buff, which enhances Assassinate's final blow. Prioritizes the enemy with the highest HP.

skills.name: Murderous Intent
skills.description: Identify the enemy's weaknesses, improving the effectiveness of your Assassinate skill.

skills.name: Sudden Raid
skills.description: Call in a horde of friends to attack enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Smokescreen
skills.description: Drop a Smokescreen near you. All party members within Smokescreen range will take no damage for the duration. For attacks that are based on max HP ratios, the damage will be reduced. Chance of Advanced Dark Sight increased within Smokescreen's range. In addition, enemies inside the Smokescreen will take more critical damage.\nYou are immune to knockback while casting Smokescreen, and Dark Sight will not deactivate upon casting.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Shadower Instinct
skills.description: Awakens your merciless Shadower's instincts, increasing your Attack, Final Damage, and Ignore Defense.

skills.name: Shadow Shifter
skills.description: Grants a chance to summon a wooden doll to take damage in your place. Also permanently increases your resistance to knockback effects when struck.

skills.name: Toxic Venom
skills.description: Increases Venom's poison chance and permanently increases poison damage.

skills.name: Dagger Expert
skills.description: Increases Dagger Mastery, Attack Power, and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Meso Explosion - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Meso Explosion's damage.

skills.name: Meso Explosion - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Enemy DEF Ignored for Meso Explosion.

skills.name: Meso Explosion - Enhance
skills.description: Increases max number of Mesos that can be used by Meso Explosion. Increases drop rate and max number of Mesos dropped from Pick Pocket and Blood Money.

skills.name: Cruel Stab - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Cruel Stab damage.

skills.name: Cruel Stab - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of enemies hit by Cruel Stab.

skills.name: Cruel Stab - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks for Cruel Stab.

skills.name: Assassinate - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Assassinate damage.

skills.name: Assassinate - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increases damage when attacking Boss Monsters with Assassinate.

skills.name: Assassinate - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Enemy DEF Ignored amount for Assassinate.

skills.name: Shadow Veil
skills.description: Summons a dark ally to deal damage over time. Chance of Advanced Dark Sight increased within Shadow Veil's attack range. Dark Sight will not deactivate upon use.

skills.name: Epic Adventure
skills.description: Call upon the bravery deep within to increase damage output.

skills.name: Flip of the Coin
skills.description: Flips a lucky coin to conjure up a random blessing, permanently increasing Critical Rate and Damage.

skills.name: Venom Burst
skills.description: Poison your weapon to deal damage over time to enemies.
skills.note: Thief-common 5th-job skill (Night Lord, Shadower, Dual Blade, Night Walker); passive in GMS 270.

skills.description: Instantly move to slash enemies.

skills.name: Trickblade
skills.description: Move behind the enemy damaged by Assassinate and Sonic Blow to deal a fatal attack. Assassinate and Sonic Blow leave a wound debuff on the highest Max HP enemy that was hit. Attacks linked with Assassinate and Sonic Blow are unaffected by attack ignore and attack reflection.

skills.name: Trickblade
skills.description: Move behind the enemy damaged by Assassinate and Sonic Blow to deal a fatal attack. Assassinate and Sonic Blow leave a wound debuff on the highest Max HP enemy that was hit. Attacks linked with Assassinate and Sonic Blow are unaffected by attack ignore and attack reflection.
skills.note: Trickblade sub-entry (same description as main).

skills.name: Sonic Blow
skills.description: Move faster than the speed of sound, dealing consecutive attacks along the way. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.\nEvery attack of Sonic Blow leaves a wound debuff on the highest Max HP enemy that was hit. Sonic Blow can be canceled immediately, by either using Shadow Assault or Trickblade, while an enemy with max wound stacks is within range. Cooldown is reduced in proportion to the remaining number of attacks.

skills.name: Slash Shadow Formation
skills.description: Team up with dark allies in a special formation to perform a joint attack. Can be used without a casting motion when used while Assassinate or Cruel Stab is in effect. Unaffected by attack reflection. Also unaffected by the effects of Shadow Partner. Use the skill again during activation to immediately call the leader.

skills.name: Last Resort
skills.description: You vow to destroy your enemies at any cost. You can renew your vow to empower its effects by using the skill again while it's active. Using the skill with the down arrow key will immediately renew your vow. With Action Customization enabled, you can renew your vow by pressing its key again, without use of the arrow keys.\nRight-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF
skills.note: Common 5th-job skill, not class-specific.

skills.description: Deals a critical hit from the shadows. Triggers an additional hit when a direct skill attack lands.\nUnaffected by buff duration increase effects.
